name: agent-raw-duotone
prompt: Raw shader effect (write the complete GLSL program yourself) that maps luminance to two colors given as color params.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

definition.label: Duotone Map

summary: I wrote `gen.duotone-map` ("Duotone Map", in the Color group). It maps each pixel's brightness onto a blend between two color params, Shadow Color and Highlight Color. It also has Midpoint, Contrast and Amount controls, and all five params are keyframeable. Nothing was checked: there were no live tools to run validate_effect, compile the shader or render frames, and nothing was staged or applied. Powermove effects only accept the body of `main()`, so the "complete program" is a body that doesn't use any of the host's helper functions; it keeps transparent edges intact.
